# v1.5.0 Release Notes — Instant Bot Apps v2, Curated Swipe-Review, Repo Explorer & Mobile Craft

![bot-team v1.5.0 Milestone Release Cover — Instant Bot Apps v2, Curated Swipe-Review, Repo Explorer & Mobile Craft](./artifact/bot-team-v150-release-cover.png)

**`bot-team v1.5.0`** elevates cross-device responsiveness, code inspection, tactile mobile ergonomics, and monochrome typographic craft across Desktop Electron, Cloud Web, iPadOS, iOS Home-Screen PWAs, Tier-2 `CoreServer`, Tier-3 `AppsDaemon`, and the Railway `cloud-gateway` (`c2d11ac..73a3993` in `bot-team` and `38bc5f8..005652d` in `bot-team-services` — **47 `bot-team` commits and 10 Cloud Gateway commits across 53 tracked issues**). Bot Apps re-architect onto **Bot Apps v2** (`#F-577`) and **WeChat Mini Program-style package pre-warming + `KeepAliveBotAppPool`** (`#F-585`), cutting warm first opens to **`14.9–26 ms`** and pooled re-opens to **`3.2 ms` with zero network requests**. Operator reading and triage gain **curated Mobile & Desktop Inbox Swipe-Review** (`#F-569`, `#F-591`), **single-host `MobileXImageViewer` with self-healing TTL media cache** (`#F-568`, `#F-598`), a **VS Code-style Repository File Explorer with recursive folder diff propagation and `0.00px`-drift code/diff gutters** (`#F-589`, `#F-580`), **dual WeChat iOS floating icon-grid & bottom-sheet context menus** (`#F-581`, `#C-597`), and a sweeping **monochrome `0.5px` / `50%` divider, unified header search, and inline/capsule tag craft pass** (`#F-584`–`#F-599`) — all with **zero edits** to the frozen 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` runtime closure (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary.mjs` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).


## Architecture Overview (`v1.5.0`)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Mobile["Mobile & iOS PWA (MobileXImageViewer · WeChat Menus · Swipe-Review · Header Search)"]
    Desktop["Desktop Mission Control (Split-Card Swipe-Review · Repo Explorer · PageHeader Search)"]
    Pool["Client App Runtime (L1 SduiRenderer · Pre-Downloader · KeepAliveBotAppPool 3.2ms)"]
    Edge["Railway Cloud Gateway (64 MB appAssetCache · SWR Edge Projections · 96 MB Media Cache)"]
    Core["Tier-2 CoreServer (repo.tree & repo.file Diff Tree · Curated Inbox · Feeds & Journals)"]
    Apps["Tier-3 AppsDaemon v2 (Always-Ready L1/L2 · L3 Warm Pool · Immutable HTML & Hashed Kit)"]
    Daemon["Tier-1 AgentDaemon (Frozen 20-File Runtime Closure · 0 Edits)"]

    Mobile <-->|"Cache-First SW + Self-Healing Media"| Edge
    Desktop <-->|"Local IPC / Cloud Mux"| Core
    Pool <-->|"Bridge v2 + Idempotent clientOpId"| Edge
    Edge <-->|"Gzip Assets + Binary WS Chunks"| Core
    Core <-->|"Host Data API & Projections"| Apps
    Core -->|"Resolved Prompts & Lifecycle"| Daemon
```


## 1. Bot Apps v2 & WeChat Mini Program-Style Instant Open (`#F-571`, `#F-577`, `#F-585` · `BOT-484`, `BOT-487`–`BOT-492`, `BOT-498`, `BOT-505`–`BOT-508`)

Opening workspace Bot Apps over remote cellular/Wi-Fi links previously incurred cold iframe boot, unversioned asset round-trips, and backend wake latency. Following the architectural rethink in `BOT-484` (`e1db89b`), `v1.5.0` ships a two-wave runtime overhaul:

- **Bot Apps v2 Tiered Runtime & Zero-Iframe `SduiRenderer` (`BOT-487`–`BOT-492`, `41a6b0d`, `81a9625`, `10ea06d`, `685dff7`, `922ab74`)**: introduces `@bot-team/app-kit`, **Host Bridge v2**, local-first snapshot caching with an idempotent `clientOpId` offline outbox, always-ready L1/L2 zero-wake state, a zero-iframe native `SduiRenderer` for L1 apps, content-addressed gzip/ETag assets, and a dedicated **`64 MB` `appAssetCache`** with singleflight coalescing and SSE-invalidated edge read projections on Railway (`bot-team-services` `f7c5371`, `45be606`). Also ships 6 static mobile/remote lint rules and redesigns `insights-and-daily-summary` into an iOS-native responsive app (`BOT-498`, `61b8d87`).
- **WeChat Mini Program-Style Pre-Download & `KeepAliveBotAppPool` (`BOT-505`–`BOT-508`, `bfb39e7`, `ee1a95a`, `30ec2eb`)**: serves immutable versioned entry HTML alongside `__bot/manifest.json` and content-hashed `/__bot/kit/<kitHash>/*` runtime modules (cached edge-first in `bot-team-services` `43fe4fc`, `6db4405` and Cache-First in the PWA Service Worker), pre-downloads app packages in the background, and retains warm mounted app instances inside `KeepAliveBotAppPool` across Mobile `apps-tab` and Desktop `app-detail` — achieving **`14.9–26 ms` warm first open** and **`3.2 ms` / `0`-network-request pooled re-open**.

![WeChat Mini Program-style instant Bot App open via package pre-download and KeepAliveBotAppPool](./artifact/bot-apps-wechat-instant-open.png)

![Bot Apps v2 Desktop host with Host Bridge v2 and instant local-first snapshot rendering](./artifact/bot-apps-v2-desktop.png)


## 2. Curated Passive Inbox Swipe-Review (`#F-569`, `#F-576`, `#C-578-1`, `#C-578-3`, `#F-591` · `BOT-479`–`BOT-486`, `BOT-493`, `BOT-494`, `BOT-515`)

Building on the Passive Magazine Inbox philosophy (zero manual Done/Ignore chores), `v1.5.0` introduces an immersive **Swipe-Review** flow tailored natively to both Mobile touchscreens and wide Desktop monitors:

- **Douyin-Style `MobileInboxSwipeView` & Shared `InboxMediaCarousel` (`BOT-479`, `BOT-480`, `BOT-482`, `a618f81`, `94fcbd6`, `9e7aea9`)**: full-screen vertical spring paging on Mobile paired with horizontal Instagram/Xiaohongshu multi-image carousels (`w=480`/`w=800` preview-to-full-res progression), inline comment/批示 dispatch, and Feed- & Gallery-synced bookmarking (`toggleInboxItemBookmark`) that keeps saved/commented stories in stream while passively marking unkept items read and auto-exiting onto `All caught up`.
- **Xiaohongshu-Web Split-Card `DesktopInboxSwipeView` (`BOT-481`, `a8bd114`)**: centered `1060×780` monochrome split-card modal with a `56%` media/editorial left stage (including full-res lightbox zoom and **Open in Panel**) and a `44%` right pane with chronological Feed thread comments, sticky reply/bookmark dock, `J`/`K` + wheel navigation, and dynamic newcomer queue appending.
- **1-Swipe Ergonomics & Curated Queue Scoping (`BOT-485`, `BOT-493`, `BOT-515`, `4a94468`, `b544c57`, `81147ab`, `d3a41a1`)**: eliminates internal card scroll traps so every vertical swipe advances cleanly (`#F-576`), consolidates `Read full` into a single action while omitting redundant dock captions on non-media editorial cards (`#C-578-1`, `#C-578-3`), and scopes Swipe-Review strictly to high-signal **`Needs You`**, **`Milestones` / `Journals` / `Explains`**, and **`Artifacts`** (`#F-591`).

![Desktop Xiaohongshu-Web split-card Inbox Swipe-Review over calm blurred backdrop](./artifact/inbox-swipe-desktop.png)

![Mobile Douyin-style full-screen Inbox Swipe-Review with Feed-synced bookmark and inline reply dock](./artifact/inbox-swipe-mobile.png)


## 3. Unified Mobile Image Browsing & Self-Healing Media Cache (`#F-568`, `#F-598` · `BOT-475`–`BOT-478`, `BOT-527`)

Every image across Mobile now opens through one cohesive, resilient viewer pipeline instead of fragmented per-tab lightboxes:

- **Single Canonical `MobileXImageViewer` Root Host (`BOT-475`–`BOT-478`, `205ac73`, `d726575`, `a4fd916`)**: mounts one root `MobileXImageViewer` in `MobileShell` driven by `mobile-image-viewer.ts`, unifying Feeds, Gallery, Journals, Inbox covers/artifacts, Feed Composer image previews, and inline Markdown images with 60fps pinch-to-zoom, double-tap zoom, horizontal gallery paging, swipe-down dismiss, and per-slide author/timestamp/entity action pills.
- **Self-Healing TTL Media Cache & Viewer Auto-Retry (`BOT-527`, `ec9b9eb`, `#F-598`)**: validates response `Content-Type` headers before writing to Cache Storage or RAM (preventing transient proxy HTML/JSON error payloads from poisoning cached images), evicts stale broken entries via TTL checks, and automatically retries with cache-busting inside the viewer if a cached blob fails to decode.

![Unified MobileXImageViewer rendering across Mobile Gallery, Journals, Inbox, and Markdown images](./artifact/mobile-unified-image-viewer.png)


## 4. VS Code-Style Repository File Explorer & `0.00px`-Drift Gutters (`#F-589`, `#F-580` · `BOT-496`, `BOT-497`, `BOT-510`–`BOT-513`)

Repository inspection expands from changed-file diffs into a full workspace code & Markdown browser across Desktop and Mobile:

- **Tier-2 `repo.tree` & `repo.file` RPCs with Folder Diff Propagation (`BOT-510`, `d65478b`)**: serves fast git-aware workspace directory trees and syntax-ready file contents from Tier-2 `RepoService`, propagating modified/added/untracked status badges recursively up ancestor folders just like VS Code.
- **Desktop & Mobile Repository Explorer + File Viewer (`BOT-511`–`BOT-513`, `7ebf16a`, `d526837`)**: adds `RepoFileExplorer` and `RepoFileViewer` (with syntax-highlighted code, rendered Markdown preview, and diff toggle) to Desktop Repository and a native drill-down Mobile Repository Explorer with iOS File Viewer sheets and long-press file path actions.
- **Pinned `0.00px`-Drift Mobile Code & Diff Line Gutters (`BOT-496`, `4c40ab8`, `#F-580`)**: isolates horizontal code scrolling from `CodeGutter` in `MobileCodeView` and pins `PierreDiffViewer` line-number columns so horizontal panning across wide code or diffs exhibits `0.00px` gutter drift.

![Desktop VS Code-style Repository File Explorer with diff-propagated folder tree and file viewer](./artifact/repo-explorer-desktop.png)

![Mobile Repository File Explorer with git status badges and touch-friendly folder drill-down](./artifact/repo-explorer-mobile.png)


## 5. WeChat iOS Dual Context Menus, Zero Tap Offset & Innermost Targeting (`#F-581`, `#F-582`, `#C-597` · `BOT-499`–`BOT-503`, `BOT-518`, `BOT-524`–`BOT-526`)

Long-pressing items on Mobile now feels crisp, spatial, and native across every single workspace tab:

- **Universal Mobile Context Menu Coverage & Minimal Mode Pin (`BOT-499`–`BOT-503`, `BOT-518`, `d3203b2`, `bd26c8b`, `f04fbbd`, `85ca502`, `980047a`)**: wires long-press context menus across Feeds (including **Pin / Unpin** in Minimal Mode `#F-582`), Inbox, Issues, Agents, Journals, Gallery, Apps, Blackboard, Memory, and Repository, using unscaled `offsetWidth`/`offsetHeight` geometry so menus never clip near viewport edges.
- **Dual WeChat iOS Floating Icon-Grid & Bottom Sheet Presentations (`BOT-524`, `7d2932d`, `490e992`, `c08f69b`, `#C-597-3`, `#C-597-4`)**: pairs a compact WeChat-style floating dark multi-column icon grid anchored cleanly to message/card targets with a bottom-stuck action sheet for list/row management contexts.
- **Zero Tap/Press Offset & Innermost-Wins Entity Claiming (`BOT-525`, `BOT-526`, `bce4cd7`, `65eec10`, `#C-597-1`, `#C-597-6`)**: removes vertical translate/scale press jitter on touch targets across Mobile tabs and implements innermost-wins target claiming so long-pressing an Issue card, Agent pill, Artifact attachment, Quoted Post, or inline entity chip inside a Feed post opens that specific entity's context menu rather than the outer post menu.

![WeChat iOS floating multi-column icon-grid context menu with zero trigger press offset](./artifact/mobile-wechat-grid-context-menu.png)


## 6. Monochrome Visual Craft, `0.5px` Dividers, Header Search & Tag Unification (`#F-584`, `#F-586`, `#C-586-1`, `#F-590`, `#F-592`–`#F-596`, `#F-599` · `BOT-504`, `BOT-509`, `BOT-514`, `BOT-516`, `BOT-517`, `BOT-519`–`BOT-523`, `BOT-528`)

A coordinated UI craft sweep refines visual hierarchy, typography, and motion across every screen:

- **Unified Top-Level Header Search & Calm Mobile Chrome (`BOT-504`, `BOT-520`–`BOT-522`, `824304e`, `1b1e8b7`, `61ef7e3`, `a83dade`)**: unifies search into the top-level Mobile header bar across all searchable tabs (including Repository) and Desktop `PageHeader` (`#F-594`), removes the redundant `+` quick-actions button from the top Mobile header (`#F-584`), and drops redundant post-submit success toasts on Mobile Feeds (`#F-595`).
- **Sharp `0.5px` + `50%` Transparent Horizontal Divide Lines (`BOT-509`, `BOT-517`, `6de39cc`, `5a5eb97`, `#F-586`, `#C-586-1`)**: introduces `--hairline-divider` (`50%` `--hairline`) and `--hairline-divider-width: 0.5px` across Dark and Light themes for all horizontal dividers (`divide-y`, horizontal `border-t`/`border-b`/`border-y`, `hr`, Markdown tables, horizontal `Separator`, and `.h-px` bars) while keeping 4-sided `.border` cards/inputs and vertical rails crisp at `1px`.
- **Mobile Mermaid `TB` Layout & Scroll Isolation (`BOT-514`, `16d3290`, `#F-590`)**: defaults Mermaid flowcharts to vertical `TB` orientation on narrow viewports for legibility and isolates internal diagram pan/scroll from outer swipe gestures.
- **Feed Tag Spring Motion, Unified `FeedTagCapsule` & Inline Typography (`BOT-516`, `BOT-519`, `BOT-523`, `BOT-528`, `2730b1e`, `1d79e91`, `3cea4d6`, `73a3993`)**: animates dynamically arriving auto-tag rows with a `0fr -> 1fr` spring reveal and staggered chip entrance (`#F-592`), removes indigo dots from channel tags and unifies channel tags + `#` hashtags into a single `20px` `rounded-full` `FeedTagCapsule` (`#F-596`), unifies clickable `.inline-tag` entity chip heights across all Markdown/Feed surfaces (`#F-593`), and renders unclickable inline `` `code` `` as flush same-size monospace text without box chrome (`#F-599`).

![Unified top-level Mobile header search morphing cleanly across tabs](./artifact/mobile-unified-header-search.png)

![Unified monochrome FeedTagCapsule pills without indigo dots alongside flush inline monospace code](./artifact/feed-capsule-tags.png)

![Unclickable inline Markdown code rendered as flush same-size monospace text next to clickable entity chips](./artifact/markdown-inline-mono-text.png)

![Retina 0.5px 50%-transparent horizontal divide lines inside crisp 1px 4-sided cards across Dark and Light themes](./artifact/horizontal-dividers-50pct.png)

## Verification & Architectural Guardrails

- **Three-Tier Runtime Boundary (`ADR 0012` · `#F-111`)**: all 47 commits since `v1.4.0` live strictly inside Tier-2 (`CoreServer`), Tier-3 (`AppsDaemon` / `@bot-team/app-kit`), renderer/mobile clients, and `bot-team-services` — leaving the 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` `DAEMON_DIST_FILES` closure 100% untouched (`node cli/test/daemon-boundary.mjs` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).
- **Automated & Playwright E2E Verification**: verified across `inbox-swipe-review.mjs` (`4/4`), `apps-v2` & `KeepAliveBotAppPool` latency benchmarks (`14.9–26 ms` warm open, `3.2 ms` / `0`-request pooled re-open), `104/104` Retina `0.5px` + `50%` divider computed-style assertions, Desktop (`1440×900`) & Mobile (`390×844`) Playwright E2E gates (`BOT-478`, `BOT-483`, `BOT-486`, `BOT-492`, `BOT-494`, `BOT-497`, `BOT-503`, `BOT-508`, `BOT-513`), `node app/scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check`, `tsc --noEmit`, `pnpm --filter @bot-team/app build`, and `pnpm lint:comments` (`0` violations).
- **Editorial Cover & Monochrome Design Rules (`#F-391` · `#C-374-1` · `#F-446` · `#F-199`)**: authored for `BOT-530` (`#F-601` Wave 1) with flat Apple Newsroom `#F5F5F7` cover art (`./artifact/bot-team-v150-release-cover.png` — pure matte `#F5F5F7` canvas, flat `#FFFFFF` cards with uniform `1px` `#D2D2D7` hairlines, zero neon, zero gradients, zero glow, and zero colored accent stripes).
